summary: Coherent, specific reflection with no clear need for a structural rewrite. A limited optional edit can compress the concluding restatement about imperfect adherence while retaining the two skipped mornings and the difference between attention and memory.
known_origin: New AI-authored synthetic evaluation source; not real user/company history

measurement.caution: Experimental uncalibrated English class outputs, not authorship probabilities or word shares. The saved 36-document pilot includes high-confidence false positives.

paragraphs.quote: For eight weeks, I read a chapter before looking at my phone in the morning. I expected the change to help me remember more of what I read. At the end of the eight weeks, I could recall the plots of three novels, but I had not tested my memory before the experiment. I therefore cannot tell whether my recall actually improved.

The change I noticed was simpler: I stopped interrupting a chapter to check messages. I liked that. I still checked my phone as soon as I finished, and on two mornings I skipped reading altogether. This was a routine I tried, not a rule I consistently followed.

I am reluctant to recommend the same routine to everyone. My mornings were quiet during those weeks, and I did not try it when I was travelling. The reading itself was worthwhile to me even without evidence of a memory benefit. Next month I want to try reading after dinner instead, although I have not chosen a start date.

occlusion.interpretation: Sensitivity to deleting a paragraph. Positive delta means removal lowered the score; length/context changes confound this. This is not causal authorship evidence or a sentence probability.

revise.issue: The routine/rule contrast summarizes the concrete lapse information immediately before it.
revise.action: Optionally integrate or shorten the adherence summary, retaining both the two skipped mornings and the fact that the routine was not consistently followed.
revise.success: The reflection reads more directly without making adherence sound perfect, changing the observations, or losing the reflective voice.

retain.preservation_rule: Eight weeks; a chapter before phone use in the morning; expected memory benefit. Read alongside the explicit lapses, not as perfect daily adherence.

retain.preservation_rule: Three novels' plots recalled at end; no baseline memory test; improvement unknown. Do not conclude improvement or no improvement.

spans.quote: The change I noticed was simpler: I stopped interrupting a chapter to check messages.

retain.preservation_rule: Observed no mid-chapter message checking and liked it. Preserve personal reaction; do not claim measured concentration, productivity, health, or memory gains.

spans.quote: I still checked my phone as soon as I finished, and on two mornings I skipped reading altogether.
This was a routine I tried, not a rule I consistently followed.

retain.preservation_rule: Still checked immediately after finishing; skipped reading on two mornings; inconsistent adherence. The summary may be rephrased but its qualification must remain.

spans.quote: I am reluctant to recommend the same routine to everyone.
My mornings were quiet during those weeks, and I did not try it when I was travelling.

retain.preservation_rule: Retain reluctance to recommend universally, quiet mornings, and untested travel context. Do not broaden to a universal prescription.

spans.quote: The reading itself was worthwhile to me even without evidence of a memory benefit.
Next month I want to try reading after dinner instead, although I have not chosen a start date.

retain.preservation_rule: Reading worthwhile regardless of absent memory evidence; desire to try after dinner next month; start date unchosen. Desire is not a scheduled commitment or completed experiment.

unresolved: Memory improvement and applicability to travel remain unknown; the next attempt has no selected start date. Leave these unresolved rather than inventing results or a schedule.
success_criterion: Adopt changes only for meaningful readability improvement with source fidelity. Detector movement alone is not improvement; leaving a sound passage intact is valid.
